description: Private Phase 22 input locations. Values are supplied by the presenter and never committed with the session.
rules: All values resolve outside the editable Git worktree.
Preparation and stage switching inspect files only; they never start inference, change a live selector, publish, or reset business data.
Every result directory is unique to its execution and retains candidate, input, tooling, model, evaluator, and policy identities.
A missing or mismatched private asset is incomplete; it is not replaced with a live read or an old result.
